name: Basic Inc.
summary: Basic Inc. develops SaaS platforms and digital solutions for B2B marketing. Its products include ferret One, which helps build websites and manage leads, formrun, a form builder needing no code, bookrun, an appointment scheduling tool, workrun, an AI-based workflow tool, and AIBOW, an AI agent system supporting routine work. Dating from 2004, it has its base in Chiyoda, Japan.
